SUBJECT: PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH HIGH WEST ENERGY FOR
SERVICES TO REMOVE AND RELOCATE AN OVERHEAD POWER LINE.
For your consideration, we offer a Professional Services Agreement with High West Energyfor the
removal and relocation of an overhead power line as part of the Christensen Railroad Overpass project.
The power line currently lies directly in the alignment of the new Christensen road between Pershing Blvd
and US30.High West will be working with the City of Cheyenne to remove the existing power line and
all infrastructure associated with it.Following the project, High West Energy will reinstalla new
underground line.The work should result inno disturbance to any of High West energy customers.It
should benoted that thisis a sole source contract due to thefact that High West isthe owner of thisline.
Funding for the Construct ability Review and Analysisis coming from the previous optional Specific
Purpose Tax (6th Penny).
In summary Staff recommends approval of the professional services agreement between the City of
Cheyenne and High West Energy in the amount of $432,000.00
